subject: Suncrest Health: Request to shift technical preview pending security portal & travel
messages:
From: Elaine Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Suncrest Health Procurement <procurement@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical preview scheduling — compliance checklist items

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for lining up the technical preview. We reviewed the kickoff materials and Legal/InfoSec have a couple of gating items before we can host an internal demo in our environment:

- Completed vendor onboarding in our portal (they need to provision a vendor account)
- Completed security questionnaire (we attached the latest version below)
- Signed NDA (we can accept DocuSign)

We have the NDA inbound but portal provisioning is queued with procurement and will likely take 2–3 weeks. Also, our CIO will be traveling the week of 6/21 so the earliest time for an exec-attended demo looks like the week of 6/28.

Given those constraints, can we either:
1) Pause the full technical preview until vendor portal + questionnaire are complete (target mid-July), or
2) Run a short pre-brief (30m) next week to align on scope and stakeholders, and follow with the full demo once the gating items are cleared?

If you prefer option 2, we can do a 30-minute alignment on 6/23 at 10:30 PT. Please let me know which you prefer and we will move forward.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Suncrest Health
[Attachment: Suncrest_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical preview scheduling — compliance checklist items

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the heads up and the questionnaire. We can absolutely accommodate a short alignment call while your procurement on-boards us to the portal. Proposed plan:

- Option A (preferred): 30-minute alignment on 6/23 at 10:30 PT to agree scope, success criteria, and who from Suncrest needs to be at the full demo. Grace (our security lead) and Ben (solutions lead) will join to answer any questionnaire items live.
- Option B: Hold the technical preview until portal provisioning and the questionnaire are complete (mid-July). We can tentatively hold dates and I'll share a calendar hold that you can confirm once procurement signals green.

For the alignment call, we can share a short prebrief agenda and a redlined copy of the questionnaire answers in advance. If you prefer the NDA via DocuSign, send the link — otherwise we can push our standard NDA through DocuSign as well.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and whether 6/23 10:30 PT works.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: quick on Suncrest gating

Chloe — quick note:

- Agree we should offer the 30m alignment to keep momentum. It’s low-effort and keeps the execs engaged.
- Laura should be looped early for legal so we can expedite any NDA follow-ups.
- Grace, if you can prepare a 10–15 minute FAQ specifically addressing the questionnaire sections that usually take longest (data retention, encryption-in-transit, audit logs), that should reduce back-and-forth.

I’ll be available for the 6/23 slot. If procurement insists on the portal-only demo, we should ask for a temporary access window for a demo or provide a recorded run-through.

—Ben

From: Elaine Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Suncrest Health Procurement <procurement@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical preview scheduling — compliance checklist items

Chloe — thanks, Option A works better for our timeline. Procurement confirms portal provisioning will take ~2 weeks to create the vendor profile and share access. NDA was received and is routing internally (DocuSign link below).

We can do 6/23 at 10:30 PT for a 30-minute alignment. Agenda items:
- Brief product scope (what you will/can show without portal access)
- Questionnaire hotspots (CS/Infra owners to speak to specific items)
- Exec attendance expectations and the timing for the full demo

Link to procurement checklist in case it helps: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/suncrest-nda-123

Thanks — I’ll calendar the 30m and loop in our security lead if needed.

Best,
Elaine

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: 6/23 10:30 PT alignment call + next steps

Thanks Elaine — confirmed for Tuesday 6/23 at 10:30 PT. Calendar invite sent.

Attached: Prebrief_Agenda.pdf and Signed_NDA_Suncrest.pdf (we completed our copy and routed it back via DocuSign). Grace will prepare a short FAQ focused on the questionnaire hotspots; Ben will cover the demo scope and what we can show without portal access. Laura — tagging you so legal can monitor the DocuSign routing in case procurement has edits.

Next steps:
- We’ll draft and circulate redlined questionnaire responses within 48 hours so procurement has something to ingest into the portal.
- If portal access arrives earlier, we’ll switch the alignment call to a short live demo; otherwise the call will be alignment-only.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the call.

Cheers,
Chloe
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Prebrief_Agenda.pdf (PDF); Signed_NDA_Suncrest.pdf (PDF)]
